description: Find the right data endpoint for a task. Searches 500+ endpoints (UK legislation, Companies House, property prices, sanctions lists, vehicle tax, weather, earthquakes, arXiv/PubMed/Crossref papers, IP geolocation, GB electricity, ONS/World Bank/ECB economics, and more) by keyword and returns each match's tool name, parameters, price and free_tier. Always free to call. Next step: pass a returned tool name to call_api.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. "legal", "property", "finance", "research", "energy", "network". See list_apis for all categories.

query.description: Keywords describing the data you need; every word must match. Examples: "postcode", "sanctions screen", "sold prices", "earthquake", "bank holiday".

name: search_apis
title: Search data APIs
